title: We're Trying to Change the World While Ignoring Our Neighbors If You Want to Change the World, Be a Good Neighbor
author: Chris Martin
source: The Ways of a Gentleman (Martin Substack), January 6, 2026
summary: Martin argues that cultural change begins not with grand ideological movements but with genuine relationship and care for those closest to us. He observes that many people are deeply invested in changing the world while neglecting the actual people they encounter daily—their neighbors, colleagues, and community members. Martin contends that a man who wants to change the world should start by being an excellent neighbor: knowing people by name, being helpful and courteous, showing up reliably, and demonstrating the kind of character he wants to see in the world. This quiet, unglamorous work of neighborhood building and genuine relationship is more revolutionary than most political ideology. Martin suggests that when enough people commit to being good neighbors, to caring for their actual community, and to living with integrity, cultural change follows naturally.
